comments.body:
# INVESTIGATION (session cd66bacc) — why the loop survives six layers of fixes, and the step-back design

## The accreted control stack (verified on main @065af7c163)

Composition order in agent_call.build_agent_kwargs (innermost to outermost): step-limit steering, memoization, completion evidence policy, runaway guard. Six shipped mitigations: criteria-scaled step floor (completion.py::verify_step_floor), path-normalized read_file memo + graduated nudges (agent_call._memo_toolsets, lever 2 of epic 10ae), one-governed-action-per-response + 3-unique-evidence-responses-per-criterion boundary (completion_tool_policy.py), runaway distinct-ratio abort (agent_call._runaway_guard_toolsets), banked incremental verdicts + batched successor recovery + deterministic finalizer (workflow/completion_recovery.py, completion_banking.py), and file_impact prefetch (workflow/completion_prefetch.py).

## Two architectural defects the layers cannot fix

**(1) The runaway guard counts memo-served repeats as loop evidence.** The guard is OUTERMOST: its call_tool appends the signature and computes the trip ratio BEFORE delegating to the memo layer (agent_call.py `_runaway_guard_toolsets` vs `_memo_toolsets`). So a re-read that lever 2 made FREE (served by slicing the path cache, zero repo round-trip) still fills the guard window and trips RunawayToolLoopError. Lever 2 and the guard fight each other: the run in this bug's repro died at distinct_ratio_window=0.5 with read_file:a0cce810 x13 — those 13 were mostly memo hits costing nothing except guard budget. The 2000-line read window (pai_tools._READ_MAX_LINES) means the 445-line architecture.md fits in ONE read; the re-requests are pure model behavior the guard punishes instead of the memo absorbing.

**(2) The finite-evidence boundary manufactures FALSE met=false.** completion_tool_policy.BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE banks met=false after three unique evidence responses — its own module header admits "a persistently batching model can bank met=false against a file that exists". A thorough-but-inefficient model therefore converts infrastructure friction into a substantive FAIL verdict, which is exactly the false-negative shape observed in the akitainu close (criteria "unmet — evidence present but not reached"). Fail-closed here is the wrong polarity: search exhaustion is EPISTEMIC (unknown), not substantive (unmet).

Root diagnosis: every fix adds another IN-BAND control (nudges, steering notices, synthetic results) to an open-ended tool loop, and the controls now conflict. The verdict's reliability is hostage to emergent model search behavior that no budget/guard tuning can bound.

## Step-back design — make the loop impossible instead of policing it

Invert the architecture: **deterministic evidence compilation + tool-free judgment**.

1. **Deterministic per-criterion dossiers (no agent).** Extend completion_prefetch from "assistance" to the PRIMARY evidence channel: for each banked-unverified criterion, compile file_impact contents, referencing-commit diffs, verify_commands output, and ticket comments into a bounded dossier (rank/skeleton-compress exactly as prefetch does today).
2. **Tool-FREE judgment calls.** Judge criteria in batches with structured output only — the model receives dossiers and returns per-criterion verdicts. No tools means no tool loop: no runaway guard, no memo, no step budget; cost is O(criteria), deterministic, cacheable.
3. **Declarative gap-fill, bounded at K rounds.** A judge may return needs_evidence [{path, line_range | symbol | grep}] instead of a verdict; the DETERMINISTIC layer fetches exactly that and re-asks. K=2 rounds; requests are data, not tool calls, so they cannot loop.
4. **Honest tri-state banking.** met / unmet / insufficient_evidence. NEVER bank met=false at a search boundary. insufficient_evidence surfaces as an actionable finding naming the missing evidence and leaves the bank entry re-checkable; met/unmet stay banked across runs (existing tree-sha stamps).
5. **Agentic fallback becomes opt-in** (config), only for criteria the dossier layer marks un-compilable; it keeps the existing guards. Also fix defect (1) regardless: the guard must count only calls that MISS the memo (observe executed work, not model chatter) — a composition change (guard inside memo) that removes the layer conflict for every agentic gate, not just completion.

Migration: (a) land the guard/memo composition fix + tri-state banking (small, kills the worst false-negatives); (b) land dossier + tool-free judgment behind verify config; (c) flip the default; agentic loop demoted to fallback. Each step independently shippable and testable against the akitainu-shaped fixture named in this ticket's AC.

Fix (a) — guard/memo recomposition — implemented and pushed as Gerrit change 1761 (commit d747216b833, worktree arthropods-guard-memo).

What shipped: new module src/rebar/llm/runaway_guard.py (ToolCallLedger + two-arm guard). The memo layer now reports EXECUTED work into a shared ledger (4 sites: non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-sig miss, read_file first-read, truncated fallback). The guard's ratio arm evaluates distinct-ratio over the EXECUTED stream only, so memo-served (free) repeats are no longer loop evidence; a served-streak backstop still bounds pure cache-served loops after a full window of zero-execution calls. Layer order unchanged (Guard->Memo->Steering); completion policy unaffected.

Validation: withheld-oracle TDD (regression test proven to fail on old guard), 6/6 manual mutants killed (mutation pass surfaced + filled 2 test gaps), lint/typecheck/499 LLM-area tests green.

Next (fix b, per the step-back design above): tri-state evidence banking — BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE currently banks met=false at search exhaustion; should bank insufficient_evidence instead. Will file as follow-up ticket linked discovered_from once change 1761 merges.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The completion-verification close gate still fails to close legitimately complete tickets: the verifier agent trips the runaway-tool-loop guard (RunawayToolLoopError) while re-reading evidence files, the gate aborts, and authors are pushed toward `--force` — the exact symptom bug 46a2-9c1a-d855-4706 set out to eliminate.

Prior art (this plan builds ON it, not around it): epic 9b71 shipped the windowed distinct-ratio runaway guard (breaker/detector). Epic 10ae/story 2948 then shipped three levers in src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py: (1) completion-policy evidence banking, (2) a path-normalized read_file memo (`_memo_toolsets`) that reads a whole file once and serves subsequent range requests by slicing the cache, (3) large-file summarize/cap handling. The loop persisted DESPITE the memo layer.

Root cause (confirmed by reading the live composition in agent_call.py): the guard sits OUTERMOST (layer-order pinned Guard→Memo→Steering), so it observes every call BEFORE the memo layer answers it. A memo-SERVED repeat — free, harmless, exactly what lever 2 was built to produce — is therefore still counted as loop evidence by the guard's distinct-ratio window. Lever 2 made repeats cheap; the guard still punishes them: the two shipped fixes fight each other. Secondary defect in the same composition: reads past the cached window fall back to uncached exact-range reads, so long files degrade the ratio further.

## Approach
Recompose guard and memo via a SHARED ledger instead of reordering layers (the completion policy sits between them and must keep seeing calls). New module src/rebar/llm/runaway_guard.py: `ToolCallLedger` tracks observed vs EXECUTED calls plus a served-streak; the memo layer calls `record_executed` at each site that performs real work (non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature miss, read_file first-read, truncated-window fallback). The guard becomes two arms: (arm 1) the distinct-ratio computed over the EXECUTED stream only — memo-served repeats are no longer loop evidence; (arm 2) a served-streak backstop that still bounds a pure cache-served loop after a FULL window of consecutive zero-execution calls (checked at call entry, before increment). Guard stays outermost; layer order unchanged; completion policy unaffected. Governance-notice loops (policy answers without delegating) stay bounded by arm 2 since policy responses never reset the streak.

Out of scope, filed as follow-up when this lands: tri-state evidence banking (BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE banks met=false at search exhaustion — should bank insufficient_evidence), to be linked discovered_from this bug.

## Scope
- src/rebar/llm/runaway_guard.py (new) — ToolCallLedger + two-arm guard.
- src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py — memo layer records executed work into the ledger (4 sites); build_agent_kwargs creates one ledger per call and passes it to both layers; old in-file guard removed.
- tests/unit/test_agent_call_memo_nudge.py — recomposition coverage.

## Testing
- Regression (withheld oracle, proven to FAIL on the old guard): a verifier pattern of 2 cached re-reads per novel call (i%3) must NOT trip the guard — memo-served repeats are not loop evidence for the ratio arm.
- Backstop: a pure cache-served loop (zero execution for a full window) still trips, with the served-streak message text distinguishing the arm.
- Non-allowlisted looping tool still trips the ratio arm (passthrough calls are executed work).
- Error-looping allowlisted tool (responses never cached) still trips the ratio arm.
- Layer-order test keeps pinning Guard→Memo→Steering.
- Manual mutation pass over the new module and the 4 record_executed sites; every mutant killed (mutation testing already surfaced and filled 2 gaps: non-allowlisted loop, error-looping exact-sig path).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A verifier run that re-reads memoized evidence files completes without RunawayToolLoopError; checked by test_memo_served_repeats_are_not_loop_evidence_for_the_ratio_arm (fails on pre-fix code).
- [ ] A genuine loop — non-allowlisted repeat, error-looping tool, or pure cache-served spin — is still bounded; checked by the three trip tests (both arms).
- [ ] Layer order and completion-policy visibility unchanged; checked by the existing layer-order test staying green.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the LLM-area test suite green; lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) before close.
